prompt:
You are auditing a Singapore residential tenancy agreement against one checklist requirement. Decide whether the agreement meets it.

Judge against the REQUIREMENT text only, not your broader opinion of the clause.
- "present": the agreement substantively meets the requirement.
- "deficient": the agreement addresses the topic but fails a stated element of the requirement (wrong figure, missing sub-condition, vague where specificity is required).
- "missing": the agreement does not address the topic at all.
The opening/preamble of the agreement counts as much as numbered clauses (rent, term, and deposit often live there).

REQUIREMENT (Problem-Free Period): Define problem-free period (typically 30 days) where landlord must rectify defects found at start.

TENANCY AGREEMENT:
RESIDENTIAL TENANCY AGREEMENT
(Singapore)
1. PARTIES TO THE AGREEMENT
LANDLORD: Mr. Tan Ah Beng
NRIC: S1234567A
Address: 123 Orchard Road, #15-01, Singapore 238123
Contact: +65 9123 4567
TENANT: Ms. Sarah Johnson
Passport: E12345678
Address: 456 Marina Bay, #20-05, Singapore 018956
Contact: +65 8765 4321
2. PROPERTY DETAILS
Property Address: 789 Clementi Avenue 3, #08-12, Singapore 129954
Property Type: 3-bedroom HDB flat
Furnished: Fully furnished
Floor Area: Approximately 90 square meters
3. RENTAL TERMS
Monthly Rent: S$2,800.00
Security Deposit: S$8,400.00 (3 months rent)
Lease Period: 24 months
Commencement Date: 1st September 2025
Expiry Date: 31st August 2027
Payment Due: 1st day of each month
Late Payment Fee: S$50.00 per day after 7 days grace period
4. TERMS AND CONDITIONS
4.1 The Tenant shall pay the monthly rent punctually without any deduction or set-off.
4.2 The security deposit shall be refunded within 14 days after the expiry of this agreement, subject
to deductions for damages, unpaid rent, or other breaches.
4.3 The Tenant is responsible for utility bills including electricity, water, gas, internet, and cable TV
charges.
4.4 No pets are allowed in the premises without prior written consent from the Landlord.
4.5 The Tenant shall maintain the property in good condition and report any damages immediately.
4.6 Subletting or assignment of this tenancy is strictly prohibited without written consent.
5. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS
5.1 The Landlord shall be responsible for major structural repairs and maintenance of fixed
installations.
5.2 The Tenant shall be responsible for minor repairs, regular cleaning, and maintenance of
movable fixtures and fittings.
5.3 Any repairs exceeding S$200.00 require prior written approval from the Landlord.
6. TERMINATION
6.1 Either party may terminate this agreement by giving 2 months written notice.
6.2 The Landlord may terminate immediately for non-payment of rent exceeding 14 days or material
breach of agreement terms.
6.3 Upon termination, the Tenant shall vacate the premises and return all keys and access cards.
7. LEGAL COMPLIANCE
7.1 This agreement is governed by Singapore law and subject to HDB regulations.
7.2 Any disputes shall be resolved through the Small Claims Tribunal or Singapore courts.
7.3 Both parties acknowledge they have read and understood all terms and conditions.
8. SIGNATURES
LANDLORD:
Signature: ___________________________ Date: _______________
Name: Mr. Tan Ah Beng
TENANT:
Signature: ___________________________ Date: _______________
Name: Ms. Sarah Johnson
WITNESS:
Signature: ___________________________ Date: _______________
Name: _________________________

Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text:
{"verdict": "present|deficient|missing", "evidence": "<clause number or 'preamble' or ''>", "reason": "<one sentence>"}
response: {"verdict": "missing", "evidence": "", "reason": "The agreement does not contain any provision defining a problem-free period for rectifying defects found at the start of the lease."}
